candidates.target_behavior: WebSocketHandler.set_nodelay should configure the active WebSocket connection during handler.open.
candidates.actual_trigger: A WebSocket handler calls set_nodelay from open before the buggy implementation's stream attribute is available.
candidates.expected_invariant: The handler can enable TCP_NODELAY and continue the WebSocket handshake/message exchange.
candidates.observed_failure: Buggy revision raises AssertionError in WebSocketHandler.set_nodelay and the client receives no message; fixed revision passes.
candidates.oracle: A local WebSocket handler calls set_nodelay(True) and sends a known message; the client must receive that message.
candidates.reproduction_status: PASS: independent probe failed on buggy and passed on fixed under Python 3.9.18 with Tornado's AsyncHTTPTestCase runner.
candidates.shared_failure_mechanism: A public API dispatches through the wrong lifecycle-specific receiver/state object.
candidates.transfer_rationale: Tests whether structured history transfers from encoding/path/control-flow bugs to a lifecycle-sensitive API receiver bug.
leak_risks: The supplied independent probe is evaluator-only and is not in the generation context.
bug.info, patch, hidden regression test, and changed-file metadata are excluded from generation.

candidates.target_behavior: Cookiecutter should run all supported hook scripts of a hook type in a generated project.
candidates.actual_trigger: A template contains multiple matching shell/python hooks and generation should execute the complete hook set.
candidates.expected_invariant: Every applicable hook runs once and contributes its observable output/state.
candidates.observed_failure: Buggy find_hook returns only one matching script; fixed code collects and runs all matching hooks.
candidates.oracle: A temporary template with multiple hooks produces all expected marker files/output after generate_files.
candidates.reproduction_status: PARTIAL: benchmark tests collected but several fixture/setup dependencies were unavailable in the shared legacy environment; source-level behavior is clear.
candidates.shared_failure_mechanism: A dispatch/selection function returns an incomplete result for a multi-item input.
candidates.transfer_rationale: Clear semantic bug, but setup uncertainty and weaker independent reproduction lower its rank.
leak_risks: Target patch and benchmark regression test are evaluator-only.
candidates.rejection_reason: Tornado had a cleaner independent buggy/fixed runtime probe and lower fixture risk.

candidates.target_behavior: tenumerate should preserve the caller's start value while wrapping the iterable.
candidates.actual_trigger: Call tenumerate with a nonzero start and inspect the yielded enumeration values.
candidates.expected_invariant: The first yielded index equals the requested start and increments normally.
candidates.observed_failure: Buggy code passes start to tqdm rather than enumerate, so enumeration starts at zero.
candidates.oracle: The public tenumerate result yields the requested starting index.
candidates.reproduction_status: NOT RUN: benchmark test collection requires the unavailable nose dependency in the shared environment.
candidates.shared_failure_mechanism: A wrapper forwards an argument to the wrong layer, changing externally visible semantics.
candidates.transfer_rationale: Good functional oracle but less lifecycle/environment diversity than Tornado.
leak_risks: Target patch and benchmark regression test are evaluator-only.
candidates.rejection_reason: Legacy test dependency was unavailable and Tornado provided stronger cross-project transfer.

candidates.target_behavior: Download filenames should remain valid when a URL-derived name exceeds filesystem limits.
candidates.actual_trigger: Download a resource whose derived filename exceeds the filesystem name limit.
candidates.expected_invariant: The download completes using a bounded valid filename.
candidates.observed_failure: Buggy code can raise OSError for a name that is too long; fixed code consults path limits and trims the name.
candidates.oracle: A local download with an overlong name completes and creates a file within the path limit.
candidates.reproduction_status: NOT RUN: benchmark collection requires pytest_httpbin, unavailable in the shared environment.
candidates.shared_failure_mechanism: An implicit filesystem/environment constraint is not handled at a public API boundary.
candidates.transfer_rationale: Strong environment trigger, but network fixture setup adds avoidable execution uncertainty.
leak_risks: Target patch and benchmark regression test are evaluator-only.
candidates.rejection_reason: Network fixture dependency and filesystem-limit setup are less reliable for this replication.

candidates.target_behavior: black should fall back when ProcessPoolExecutor cannot be created in a restricted runtime such as AWS Lambda.
candidates.actual_trigger: Run reformat_many in an environment where process-pool creation raises OSError.
candidates.expected_invariant: Formatting completes through the sequential fallback.
candidates.observed_failure: Buggy code propagates pool-creation OSError; fixed code catches it and falls back.
candidates.oracle: Formatting a small source file completes despite process-pool initialization failure.
candidates.reproduction_status: NOT RUN: benchmark collection requires legacy regex/toml dependencies unavailable in the shared environment.
candidates.shared_failure_mechanism: A runtime/environment failure should be handled by a public fallback path.
candidates.transfer_rationale: Interesting environment perturbation, but monkeypatch/process behavior makes the harness fragile.
leak_risks: Target patch and benchmark regression test are evaluator-only.
candidates.rejection_reason: Dependency and process-pool setup risk were higher than the selected target.
